Definition: Megiddon or Megiddo, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Megiddo or Megiddon = "place of crowds"; 1) ancient city of Canaan assigned to Manasseh and located on the southern rim of the plain of Esdraelon 6 miles (10 km) from Mount Carmel and 11 miles (18 km) from Nazareth
